thread:
devon: :rotating_light: heads up — we're seeing progressive degradation in east1c GPU pool (node fencing + packet-loss spikes). A bunch of pods are pending or stuck on drain.
ana: Copy. Which instance group? partial or whole AZ?
liam: Looks like gpu-pool-east1c-1, about 6/24 nodes reporting NIC flaps. Autoscaler hasn't kicked because nodes still 'Ready' then go to 'Unknown'.
mira: Alert from SRE monitor just fired: CPU fine, NIC error rate and kubelet heartbeat failures.

sre-bot: ALERT: Cluster east1c (gpu-prod) — Node NIC errors > 5% for 00:08. 6 nodes affected. Suggested action: cordon+evacuate impacted nodes, shift traffic to east1b/west1 if capacity allows.

devon: Ok. Plan suggestion:
1) cordon the 6 impacted nodes
2) drain them (graceful) with fallback to start hot-failover instances in west1
3) incrementally shift 25% -> 50% -> 100% workload away if we see more failures
4) keep an eye on cost — west1 uses on-demand burst, we should avoid full region failover unless needed

ana: Agree. I'll cordon first and start drains. Liam — can you check autoscaler & remaining spare capacity in east1b/west1 and validate network ACLs? Mira — watch p99 latency for in-flight requests.

liam: Checking autoscaler. Current spare GPU capacity: east1b ~ 12 GPUs, west1 ~ 8 GPUs available for burst. Autoscaler policy will spin up from template, but boot time ~4-6m.
mira: Watching p99. If we shift too fast we might spike queue times. Suggest incremental percentages and short stabilisation windows.

devon: Commands I'll run now:
```
kubectl cordon east1c-gpu-07
kubectl drain east1c-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
I'll tag drains with `evac/1763001234` for audit.

ops-oncall: FYI I'm opening a temporary routing rule in the edge LB to shift 30% of new sessions to west1 to relieve east1c. Will monitor health checks. If LB health fails, rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Scheduled drain job started for nodes: east1c-gpu-07, -12, -16, -18, -19, -23. ETA per node ~2-4min.

liam: Autoscaler noticed surge, I've bumped desired in west1 by +4 instances (preemptible where possible). Also marked instance template to use newer NIC drivers (workaround) for the next batch.

mira: p99 spike: +80ms at first shift to 30%, now stabilising. No error-rate increase. Keep going slow.

ana: So far 4 nodes drained, pods rescheduled. One pod failed to attach volume after reschedule (CSI timeout). Restarted CSI controller, requeued mount.

devon: Important — we should avoid cross-region storage hot-move; prefer to drain GPU workloads that are stateless / cache-friendly. Added label `evac-suitable=true` to scheduling filter for canary reschedules.

ops-oncall: Routing 1 -> 3 -> 5 minute windows: shifted 30% now, holding 10m, then shift to 60% if metrics look good.

sre-bot: NOTE: cost estimate for west1 burst (current delta): +$1.8k/hr if we sustain 60% traffic. Logging to incident ticket #INC-1589.

devon: Good call — keep finance on the loop, but prioritize availability. If we see node fencing continue beyond 30m in east1c, we'll promote west1 as primary and start decommission plan for affected nodes.

mira: 20m in — east1c node fencing rate slowed, 2 new nodes started failing. I'm in favor of continued slow shift, not full failover yet. p99 steady.

liam: I've created a short-lived instance replacement job to reprovision the 6 affected nodes with patched kernel + NIC driver. Will run after drains finish to avoid double-scheduling.

ana: Drains complete for first 6. CSI mounts recovered after controller restart. Rolling healthchecks show green for west1 and east1b.

devon: Action items: 
- liam: run reprovision job and report completion (ETA 30m)
- ops-oncall: keep routing policy staged, don't exceed 60% unless asked
- mira: keep monitoring latency & error budget
- ana: audit evicted pods list and reopen anything that fails to come up

mira: ack
liam: on it (starting reprovision job now)
ops-oncall: keeping stage at 30% -> hold
a na: audit started

devon: Thanks team. I'll update the incident ticket and ping finance. We'll reconvene in 30m or sooner if things regress. :thumbsup:
